suites.notes: The #9106 walking skeleton (#12232), steps 1 and 2: a signed record read back from its id:// address, then written on one in-process node, synced to a second, and a conflicting write reported on both. Step 3 (substrate_transport_path) runs the same path between two OS processes over the iroh transport (/id-fed-exchange/1); it needs UDP loopback, so it runs where UDP is available (the laptop, CI) and not in the Muse sandbox. Step B3 (walk_cli_path) drives the same five steps through the id walk CLI surface against on-disk nodes, restarting the holding node between stages. The only substrate suites that import from id_core and id_sync instead of including modules by path, so they also fail to compile when a substrate module stops being part of its crate. Direct run: cargo test --manifest-path pkgs/id/Cargo.toml -p id-core --test substrate_path && cargo test --manifest-path pkgs/id/Cargo.toml -p id-sync --test substrate_sync_path && cargo test --manifest-path pkgs/id/Cargo.toml -p id-sync --test substrate_transport_path && cargo test --manifest-path pkgs/id/Cargo.toml -p id-cli --test walk_cli_path.
